The '''CorSec vs. Flail Battle''' took place on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="SWG:CvFB" /> the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization<ref name="SoC">{{WizCite|story=Shadows of Coruscant|book=Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook}}</ref> known as [[the Flail]] was active on the planet Talus, in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. However, the [[Corellian Security Force]] was always watchful for the criminal element on their worlds and,<ref name="SWG:CvFB" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> it finally discovered the location of the [[Flail hideout]] on Talus. A CorSec [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] landed in a small valley leading to the Flail hideout and deployed its troops. A small camp was established at the landing site where a CorSec [[Captain/Legends|captain]] commanded the operations. Two dozens of CorSec [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] led by [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]] went up the valley to the hideout. However, Flail cutthroats went down from the building before the CorSec could reach the hideout and the two groups clashed in the middle of the valley.<ref name="SWG:CvFB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Corsec vs. Flail Battle appears in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CvFB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> It was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]," released on [[August 3]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref>
